remarks: Incredibly maintained Thomas Johnson-built home in The Summit at Scherff, one of Western New York’s most sought-after neighborhoods, set on a private wooded lot backing to Chestnut Ridge Park. The exterior combines timeless architecture with low-maintenance materials, including James Hardie siding, AZEK trim, Marvin windows and Citadel stone. Inside, a dramatic two-story foyer is highlighted by a three-part oak staircase and showcases the craftsmanship found throughout the home. Much of the first floor features pristine oak hardwoods, extensive millwork and built-ins, along with transom and arched-top windows that fill the home with natural light. The spacious cherry kitchen offers abundant cabinetry and counter space, a large center island and adjoining dining area, with easy access to both the peaceful enclosed three-season room and covered deck. A full bath completes the first floor. Upstairs, the generous primary suite features vaulted ceilings, dual closets and a spacious private bath. Four additional bedrooms offer excellent space and large walk-in closets, complemented by a compartmentalized Jack-and-Jill bath. The walkout lower level features extensive glass and abundant natural light, offering tremendous potential for additional finished living space. Exceptional setting, quality construction and meticulous care throughout. Square footage measured confirmed from original house plans.
